form.title: Create your account
form.business_name_hint: Your cable business, for example Anmol Cable Network.
form.mobile_hint: You can sign in with this number too.
form.email_hint: We send a link here to check that it is yours.
form.password_hint: At least 8 letters, numbers or signs.
form.person_check_label: Check that you are a person

error.fix_fields: Fix the boxes marked in red.
error.too_long: This is too long. Make it shorter.
error.email_invalid: Check the email. It looks like name@example.com.
error.password_too_short: Use at least 8 letters, numbers or signs.
error.password_too_long: Use at most 128 letters, numbers or signs.
error.rate_limited: Too many tries. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
error.person_check_failed: We could not check that you are a person. Try again.
error.email_failed: We could not send the email. Try again in a minute.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to start. The link works for 24 hours.
sent.not_there: Not there? Look in the Spam folder, or create the account again.

verify.title: Start Cable Billing
verify.description: Your email is confirmed. Type your password to start your 30 free days.
verify.wrong_password: Wrong password. Type the password you chose when you created the account.
verify.account_exists: This email already has an account. Sign in.
verify.invalid_body: It is old or was already used. If you already started, sign in. If not, create the account again.

email.verify_subject: Confirm your email for Cable Billing
email.verify_intro: Hello! An account for Cable Billing was created with this email.
email.verify_action: Open this link to start your 30 free days. It works for {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}:
email.verify_ignore: Did you not create it? Ignore this email. Nothing will happen.
email.existing_subject: You already have a Cable Billing account
email.existing_intro: Someone tried to create a Cable Billing account with this email, but it already has one.
email.existing_reset: Forgot your password? Get a new one here:
email.existing_ignore: Was it not you? Ignore this email. Nothing changed.
